1475:         Reference chord intervals to score against.
1476:     estimated_intervals : np.ndarray, shape=(m, 2), dtype=float
1477:         Estimated chord intervals to score against.
1478: 
1479:     Returns
1480:     -------
1481:     segmentation score : float
1482:         Comparison score, in [0.0, 1.0], where 1.0 means perfect segmentation.
1483:     """
1484:     return min(
1485:         underseg(reference_intervals, estimated_intervals),
1486:         overseg(reference_intervals, estimated_intervals),
1487:     )
1488: 
1489: 
1490: def merge_chord_intervals(intervals, labels):
1491:     """
1492:     Merge consecutive chord intervals if they represent the same chord.
1493: 
1494:     Parameters
1495:     ----------
1496:     intervals : np.ndarray, shape=(n, 2), dtype=float
1497:         Chord intervals to be merged, in the format returned by
1498:         :func:`mir_eval.io.load_labeled_intervals`.
1499:     labels : list, shape=(n,)
1500:         Chord labels to be merged, in the format returned by
1501:         :func:`mir_eval.io.load_labeled_intervals`.
1502: 
1503:     Returns
1504:     -------
1505:     merged_ivs : np.ndarray, shape=(k, 2), dtype=float
1506:         Merged chord intervals, k <= n
1507: 
1508:     """
1509:     roots, semitones, basses = encode_many(labels, True)
1510:     merged_ivs = []
1511:     prev_rt = None
1512:     prev_st = None
1513:     prev_ba = None
1514:     for s, e, rt, st, ba in zip(
1515:         intervals[:, 0], intervals[:, 1], roots, semitones, basses
1516:     ):
1517:         if rt != prev_rt or (st != prev_st).any() or ba != prev_ba:
1518:             prev_rt, prev_st, prev_ba = rt, st, ba
1519:             merged_ivs.append([s, e])
1520:         else:
1521:             merged_ivs[-1][-1] = e
1522:     return np.array(merged_ivs)
1523: 
1524: 
1525: def evaluate(ref_intervals, ref_labels, est_intervals, est_labels, **kwargs):
1526:     """Compute weighted accuracy for all comparison functions for the given
1527:     reference and estimated annotations.
1528: 
1529:     Examples
1530:     --------
1531:     >>> (ref_intervals,
1532:     ...  ref_labels) = mir_eval.io.load_labeled_intervals('ref.lab')
1533:     >>> (est_intervals,
1534:     ...  est_labels) = mir_eval.io.load_labeled_intervals('est.lab')
1535:     >>> scores = mir_eval.chord.evaluate(ref_intervals, ref_labels,
1536:     ...                                  est_intervals, est_labels)
1537: 
1538:     Parameters
1539:     ----------
1540:     ref_intervals : np.ndarray, shape=(n, 2)
1541:         Reference chord intervals, in the format returned by
1542:         :func:`mir_eval.io.load_labeled_intervals`.
1543:     ref_labels : list, shape=(n,)
1544:         reference chord labels, in the format returned by
1545:         :func:`mir_eval.io.load_labeled_intervals`.
1546:     est_intervals : np.ndarray, shape=(m, 2)
1547:         estimated chord intervals, in the format returned by
1548:         :func:`mir_eval.io.load_labeled_intervals`.
1549:     est_labels : list, shape=(m,)
1550:         estimated chord labels, in the format returned by
1551:         :func:`mir_eval.io.load_labeled_intervals`.
1552:     **kwargs
1553:         Additional keyword arguments which will be passed to the
1554:         appropriate metric or preprocessing functions.
1555: 
1556:     Returns
1557:     -------
1558:     scores : dict
1559:         Dictionary of scores, where the key is the metric name (str) and
1560:         the value is the (float) score achieved.
1561: 
1562:     """
1563:     # Append or crop estimated intervals so their span is the same as reference
1564:     est_intervals, est_labels = util.adjust_intervals(
1565:         est_intervals,
1566:         est_labels,
1567:         ref_intervals.min(),
1568:         ref_intervals.max(),
1569:         NO_CHORD,
1570:         NO_CHORD,
1571:     )
1572:     # use merged intervals for segmentation evaluation
1573:     merged_ref_intervals = merge_chord_intervals(ref_intervals, ref_labels)
1574:     merged_est_intervals = merge_chord_intervals(est_intervals, est_labels)
1575:     # Adjust the labels so that they span the same intervals
1576:     intervals, ref_labels, est_labels = util.merge_labeled_intervals(
1577:         ref_intervals, ref_labels, est_intervals, est_labels
1578:     )
1579:     # Convert intervals to durations (used as weights)
1580:     durations = util.intervals_to_durations(intervals)
1581: 
1582:     # Store scores for each comparison function
1583:     scores = collections.OrderedDict()
1584: 
1585:     scores["thirds"] = weighted_accuracy(thirds(ref_labels, est_labels), durations)
1586:     scores["thirds_inv"] = weighted_accuracy(
1587:         thirds_inv(ref_labels, est_labels), durations
1588:     )
1589:     scores["triads"] = weighted_accuracy(triads(ref_labels, est_labels), durations)
1590:     scores["triads_inv"] = weighted_accuracy(
1591:         triads_inv(ref_labels, est_labels), durations
1592:     )
1593:     scores["tetrads"] = weighted_accuracy(tetrads(ref_labels, est_labels), durations)
1594:     scores["tetrads_inv"] = weighted_accuracy(
1595:         tetrads_inv(ref_labels, est_labels), durations
1596:     )
1597:     scores["root"] = weighted_accuracy(root(ref_labels, est_labels), durations)
1598:     scores["mirex"] = weighted_accuracy(mirex(ref_labels, est_labels), durations)
1599:     scores["majmin"] = weighted_accuracy(majmin(ref_labels, est_labels), durations)
1600:     scores["majmin_inv"] = weighted_accuracy(
1601:         majmin_inv(ref_labels, est_labels), durations
1602:     )
1603:     scores["sevenths"] = weighted_accuracy(sevenths(ref_labels, est_labels), durations)
1604:     scores["sevenths_inv"] = weighted_accuracy(
1605:         sevenths_inv(ref_labels, est_labels), durations
1606:     )
1607:     scores["underseg"] = underseg(merged_ref_intervals, merged_est_intervals)
1608:     scores["overseg"] = overseg(merged_ref_intervals, merged_est_intervals)
1609:     scores["seg"] = min(scores["overseg"], scores["underseg"])
1610: 
1611:     return scores
